scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare; full recompute not possible because the agent only produces final aggregated values, not the raw temperature/time profiles.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for melt duration, temperature gradient, nucleation density and rate
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'temperature gradient is about 1x10^5 K/cm (dashed curve) at the critical melt duration for amorphization threshold energy for each film thickness'; melt durations derived from numerical analysis (Fig.11); nucleation density '4x10^22 m^-3' and rate '8x10^30 m^-3 s^-1' stated in paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Taken directly from the paper's reported numbers; the oracle solve.sh hardcodes these values as the correct answer.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the author's reported experimental/simulation results; no fabrication needed.

outputs.description: Simulation results for melt duration and temperature gradient at the Si/quartz interface for three film thicknesses.
Estimated minimum crystalline nucleation density and nucleation rate.

output_contract.notes: All values are to be compared against hidden paper-reported reference values with relative tolerances.
